context_requirements: Expression of cannabinoid receptors CNR1, CNR2, GPR55, or GPR18 on the cell line
An active endocannabinoid tone or constitutive receptor activity for antagonists to block
G-protein signaling competent for Gi/o-mediated cAMP modulation
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h after 10 micromolar antagonist treatment in any of the nine lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines that is absent with vehicle and absent with an inactive structural analog
Changes in cAMP-responsive genes such as FOS, JUN, or EGR1 that are reversed by CNR1/CNR2 agonists

evidence.supports: Cannabinoid receptor antagonists SR141716 and SR144528 modulate effects of cannabidiol in glioma cells, indicating receptor-dependent pharmacology in some contexts
Prolonged cannabinoid exposure alters delta opioid receptor mRNA and cAMP signaling in NG108-15 cells, showing cannabinoid receptor pathway can regulate transcription
